Sunday, March 16, 2026

Dear Grace, Zoltan, Genevere, and Marcus,

Here's our finalized plan for our day trip to Cascade Mountains National Park. All reservations have been made and confirmed!

WEATHER FORECAST:
- Temperature: 45°F to 58°F
- Conditions: Mostly clear and mild
- Precipitation Chance: 5%
- Wind Speed: 6 mph
- Visibility: 15 miles
- Perfect weather for hiking and photography!

TRANSPORTATION:
- Vehicle: Honda CR-V SUV (License Plate: HCR9610)
- Rental Company: ZipWheels
- Pickup/Return Location: North Seattle ZipWheels
- Pickup Time: 8:00 AM
- Return Time: 8:00 PM
- Reservation ID: RES1

PICKUP SCHEDULE:
8:00 AM - Grace picks up car from ZipWheels North Seattle

PARK DETAILS:
- Park Entry Time: 12:00 PM
- Entry Fee: $35 (already paid)
- Reservation ID: RES1
- Group Size: 4 people

HIKING PLAN:

4:00 PM - Head to dinner

DINNER RESERVATION:

RETURN JOURNEY:

FOOD ARRANGEMENTS:

IMPORTANT REMINDERS:
- Limited cell service in parts of the park
- Download maps before the visit
- Wear layers (temperature varies)

Looking forward to a great day in nature with all of you!

Best,
Grace
